sequence: Job A resolves a NativeArray view from GlobalDataVault while arena base is oldBase.
Arena growth copies bytes to newBase and frees oldBase.
Job A writes through its old pointer after the free.
The write targets freed unmanaged memory; C# exceptions cannot catch it and Unity may hard-crash.
